name: orchestrator
description: Phase 2 - the search loop (PLAN.md 2.1). Runs as an in-process LOOP. Each outer epoch: REFRESH -> INIT_K (FANOUT_K tunable) -> INIT_I -> inner fan-out loop [SAMPLE (sample-config -> parent_id, Thompson) -> CLAIM_SEED_IDEA -> FANOUT (spawn lineage-{{i}} run-experiment, fire-and-forget) -> INCR_I -> LOOP_BRANCH] -> JOIN (empty wait_for = all N) -> LOG (+ ideas.py render) -> back to REFRESH. IDEA FLOW: the mutator GENERATES its own hypotheses; CLAIM_SEED_IDEA only reserves an optional INSPIRATION seed from the shared pool and prints 'none' when the pool is empty (a normal state, not the old idea-default-noop degenerate path). The old READ_IDEA + CLAIM_IDEA grep/sed pair collapsed into this single block because ideas.py claim IS an atomic read-and-claim under flock. The K claims are SERIAL (this loop is sequential; only FANOUT is async), so the K seeds are distinct without further coordination. NOTE: this loop has no exit - END is intentionally unreachable - so it runs until the engine block cap (--max-blocks, walker.py) trips.

init_k.name: INIT_FANOUT_K
init_k.command:
set -eu
PY=/home/acer01/axi-assistant/.venv/bin/python
SCRIPTS=/home/acer01/axi-assistant/user-data/autoresearch/scripts
"$PY" -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '$SCRIPTS'); import tunables; print(tunables.fanout_k())"

log.name: LOG_EPOCH
log.command:
set -eu
AR="${AUTORES_ROOT:-/home/acer01/axi-assistant/user-data/autoresearch}"
PY=/home/acer01/axi-assistant/.venv/bin/python
SCRIPTS="$AR/scripts"
echo "$(date +%FT%T) epoch parent={{parent_id}} seed={{seed_idea_id}} fanout={{fanout_n}}" >> "$AR/epoch.log"
# Epoch boundary is the explicit render point (a whole-file rewrite takes the
# lock, so it must not run per-append). Drift exits 2 and is reported, not fatal.
"$PY" "$SCRIPTS/ideas.py" render || echo "ideas: render skipped (see message above)"
tail -1 "$AR/results.tsv" 2>/dev/null || true

claim_seed.name: CLAIM_SEED_IDEA
claim_seed.command:
set -eu
AR="${AUTORES_ROOT:-/home/acer01/axi-assistant/user-data/autoresearch}"
PY=/home/acer01/axi-assistant/.venv/bin/python
SCRIPTS="$AR/scripts"
# Atomic test-and-set under flock. Prints 'none' when the pool is empty, which
# is a NORMAL state: the mutator then generates unseeded. Never fails the epoch.
"$PY" "$SCRIPTS/ideas.py" claim --lineage "lineage-{{i}}" --purpose seed 2>/dev/null || echo none
